business_problem: DI Square needed to improve call-center operator productivity and reduce dependence on individual know-how as labor shortages and higher staffing costs made it harder to hire, train, and retain operators.
solution_summary: DI Square extended its EasyAnswer Series with EasyAnswer JINN/RAG-Opt, a call-center support capability built around a custom retrieval-augmented-generation architecture using IBM AI services. The system links company data such as customer information, inquiry history, manuals, regulations, and product data to IBM watsonx Assistant, IBM Watson Discovery, and the Japanese version of IBM Granite delivered through watsonx.ai. Operators type questions into the interface and the assistant searches company knowledge to present appropriate answer candidates and relevant past conversations, helping them respond faster and more consistently. Over time, usage feeds new findings and corrected knowledge back into the system so answer quality can improve and standardize across the operation. In practice, the solution becomes a governed knowledge-assistance layer for call centers, combining enterprise retrieval with Japanese-language LLM performance tuned for business use.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Provides the virtual-agent interface that operators use to search and receive answer candidates.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Delivers the AI runtime that hosts Granite and the solution's RAG workflows.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery
solution_components.role: Processes and retrieves company documents and knowledge for operator assistance.

solution_components.name: IBM Granite
solution_components.role: Supplies the Japanese-language large language model used to generate business-ready answer candidates.

data_flow: Customer information, inquiry history, manuals, regulations, and product data are indexed into the RAG architecture, operators submit questions through watsonx Assistant, Watson Discovery retrieves relevant knowledge, and Granite on watsonx.ai generates answer candidates and uses past conversation history to support the response.
business_outcome: DI Square created a call-center knowledge assistant that helps operators search faster, standardize answers, and increase response productivity while preserving and reusing accumulated know-how.
